operator_acceptance.approval_scope: 20 SHORT_MESSAGE_MEANING learner-facing items and A1/A1+ language ceiling

language_ceiling.purpose: Preserve the KET communicative-purpose mechanic without introducing later-level relative-clause grammar.

items.message: Mum, my toy car is under the bed. Can you bring it to me?

options: To ask Mum to bring his toy car.
To tell Mum to put his shoes by the door.
To invite Mum to play with his ball.
